title: [main]-Multiple error messages when posting to period with VAT Return already in status Released
summary: Posting to a period whose VAT Return is already in status Released should no longer produce multiple error messages. The change updates the VAT Reporting Date Mgt codeunit and makes a one-line change to the VAT Entry table in each layer.
key_points: Addresses duplicate error messages when posting into a period with a Released VAT Return
VAT Reporting Date Mgt codeunit modified
VAT Entry table changed in the W1 layer and all localized layers
Tests added to ERM VAT Sales Purchase in several localization layers
quote: Multiple error messages when posting to period with VAT Return already in status Released
